P01.rationale: The page features two large, prominent portraits of founders that serve as the dominant human anchors for their respective case studies.

P05.rationale: Each case study clearly frames a named client portrait at a meaningful size (roughly one-third of the column) rather than leaving an empty gap.

P07.rationale: A social-proof apparatus is present in the form of specific testimonials and logos, though it lacks a broader press wall or rating grid.

P10.rationale: There are no oversized decorative typographic elements like giant ghost numerals or large quote glyphs visible on this page.

P11.rationale: The page contains real data-visualisations bound to specific numbers (e.g., '€200.000', '90 days') rather than empty chart frames.

P12.rationale: The layout reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial design that fills the sheet with text and imagery without appearing sparse.

P13.rationale: There is an intentional background texture/atmosphere provided by the subtle geometric patterns behind the portraits, avoiding flat blankness.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photos are treated with a light blue scrim/darkening so that any overlaid text remains perfectly readable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown to add real product credibility; the focus is strictly on human portraits and data.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks specific to a real business context rather than generic stock photography, though it lacks unique environmental details.

N08.rationale: There is minimal purposeless dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content in both columns and headers.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo without a scrim or awkward inset gap; it is clearly separated by the background treatment.
